content: Zen Browser uses @zen-browser/surfer (v1.14.8, TypeScript CLI, ~20 deps) driven by surfer.json: name/vendor/appId/binaryName/version{product,version,candidate}/buildOptions.generateBranding/brands{release,twilight}{backgroundColor,brandShorterName,brandShortName,brandFullName,release{displayVersion,github.repo,archives}}/license/updateHostname. branding-patch.ts copies template/branding.optional through a plain ${var} stringTemplate substitution, then fills gaps by copying browser/branding/unofficial, writing into engine/browser/branding/<brand>. Requires pre-rendered logo{16,22,24,32,48,64,128,256,512}.png (its @resvg/resvg-js import is dead); uses sharp for about-logo resize, png-to-ico and async-icns for Windows/macOS icons.
